themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Surge
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints exploded to 4 THIS WEEK—a 3100% spike vs. 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.72)—suggesting a sudden public health or sanitation issue requiring immediate investigation into cause and scope.
evidence: 4 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 11.72)
3100% increase marks the highest statistical anomaly in district data
Spike is isolated to current week, suggesting acute event rather than chronic problem
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about whether a specific location or animal source is driving complaints
Check if complaints cluster geographically (waterfront, park, residential block) to identify root cause

themes_detail.label: Food Poisoning Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints hit 5 THIS WEEK—a 300% spike vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.67)—concentrated in a dense restaurant/food service district, warranting health dept investigation into potential outbreak or vendor hygiene breakdown.
evidence: 5 food poisoning complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (z-score: 5.67)
300% spike coincides with warm weather and heightened foot traffic in Murray Hill restaurant corridor
Mobile food vendor complaints also spiked 1100% two weeks ago, suggesting food service sector stress
reporting_angles: Request DOHMH inspection logs for Murray Hill/Gramercy restaurants filed this week; identify any pattern in violation types
Interview affected residents to determine if complaints cluster around specific vendor, restaurant, or food type

themes_detail.label: Tree Health Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints surged to 4 THIS WEEK—a 540% spike vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.94)—suggesting either heat stress, disease, or deferred maintenance affecting the district's canopy at a critical moment.
evidence: 4 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 3.94)
540% spike aligned with recent heat and drought stress across NYC
Community board has repeated budget requests for tree maintenance, indicating systemic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Map complaint locations to identify if trees are concentrated in one park, street, or district section
Interview Parks Department about whether this week's heat triggered visible decline in tree health; request inspection protocol

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Spike
themes_detail.summary: Hazardous materials complaints hit 3 LAST WEEK—a 380% spike vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.91)—potentially linked to construction or industrial activity, warranting clarification on source and neighborhood exposure risk.
evidence: 3 hazardous materials complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 4.91)
380% spike concurrent with 1313 DOB building permits filed in district over 90 days (30 full demolitions, 1193 alterations)
Derelict vehicle complaints also spiked 1100% two weeks ago, suggesting broader environmental/infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Cross-reference hazmat complaint addresses with active DOB demolition and alteration permits to identify construction-linked exposure
Contact FDNY HazMat unit to determine what substances were reported and whether cleanup occurred

themes_detail.label: Residential Noise Decline
themes_detail.summary: Residential noise complaints DROPPED 48% THIS WEEK to 50 vs. 97.1 weekly average (z-score: -6.54)—a statistically significant reversal of the district's highest-volume complaint category, suggesting either community behavior shift, reporting fatigue, or seasonal change worth understanding.
evidence: 50 residential noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 97.1 weekly average (z-score: -6.54, -48% decline)
Residential noise is normally highest-volume complaint category (1122 over 90 days) but dropped sharply this week
Decline contradicts seasonal pattern (warm weather typically increases outdoor noise); may indicate summer exodus or enforcement activity
reporting_angles: Check if NYPD or 311 enforcement operations ramped up or if community board held awareness campaign
Survey residents on whether they've left the district (summer travel) or if noise environment genuinely improved
